title: French stream fish community data (ONEMA / OFB electrofishing surveys) — onema
text: source data organized around fishing *operations* (`opcod`): several electrofishing operations can carried *station* time. `onema` aggregates one row per station: every operation first mapped station (`fishing_protocol.csv`), biomass (grams) summed every operation recorded given station, separately species (.e. `biomass[s, ]` total biomass species ever caught station `s`, single operation's catch). Stations without environmental data dropped. Species observed fewer 10 stations also dropped: level rarity, zero-inflated fit's iterative initialization can fit species' handful non-zero observations exactly, driving estimated noise precision infinity (species also carry essentially information clustering anyway).
